title: Web Application Firewall
subtitle: · ModSecurity v3 + OWASP Core Rule Set. Saving re-renders the nginx vhost (zero downtime).

moduleWarning.bold: The ModSecurity module is not installed on this server.
moduleWarning.pre: Settings are saved but WAF is not applied. Run
moduleWarning.post: on the server to enable it (existing sites are not affected).

inherit.name: Inherit from Plan
inherit.description: This domain uses the WAF default from its assigned service plan.

block.name: Block
block.description: Malicious requests (SQLi, XSS, RCE…) are blocked with 403. SecRuleEngine On.

detect.name: Detect
detect.description: Requests are not blocked; matching rules are written to the audit log only. DetectionOnly — ideal for rule tuning.

off.name: Off
off.description: WAF is completely disabled for this domain (even if the plan has it enabled).

paranoiaDescription.1: Low — basic attack signatures. Almost no false positives. (recommended)
paranoiaDescription.2: Medium — more rules. Some legitimate requests may be blocked.
paranoiaDescription.3: High — aggressive. Per-application exclusions may be needed.
paranoiaDescription.4: Strict — most aggressive. Only for tightly audited scenarios.

paranoiaCard.title: Paranoia Level (CRS)

hint.pre: A higher level = more rules + stronger protection, but also a higher chance of false positives. Only effective when WAF is in

paranoiaCard.highLevelWarning: At levels 3 and 4 the OWASP core rule set evaluates far more rules on every request, which raises CPU use and response time. Weigh that on a small server.

messages.savedPassive: Settings saved — WAF is passive for this domain
